lead: Shammi Kapoor was an Indian stage actor, born on 21 October 1930 in Mumbai.
He died on 14 August 2011 in Mumbai at the age of 80.
He has 60 credited works on public record and has been recognised with Filmfare Awards and IIFA Lifetime Achievement Award.
This profile collects the Shammi facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Shammi Kapoor — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Shammi Kapoor was born on 21 October 1930 in Mumbai, and holds citizenship of India, British Raj and Dominion of India.
Public records name his father, Prithviraj Kapoor and his mother, Ramsarni Kapoor. He is a sibling of Raj Kapoor and Shashi Kapoor.
He received his education at Don Bosco High School.
